payload.title: A small normalization change

payload.transcript:
# aider chat started at 2026-01-01 00:00:00

I added casefold() after strip(). This maps Straße to strasse.
checkpoints.patch:
diff --git a/normalize.py b/normalize.py
index d965259..191f20e 100644

@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
